_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. fal.ai declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* (the app colour scales and type/space/motion layer, the marketing Webflow palette, the docs layer), the theme-dependent semantic roles under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
